notes: This contract pins Umbra's opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 object-instance foundation to the exact C++ API surfaces exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies official signatures, declared exception sets, adapter symbols, and real Catch2 selectors for unnamed registration, discovery, and known-instance lookup only. The development profile generates a unique name for the unnamed overload, snapshots currently published attributes as private registration ownership state, and dispatches non-region discovery through the recipient's immediate or evoked callback model. A separate fresh-registry application-value companion uses unnamed registration as the object identity source for one durable latest value; it does not broaden this contract to callback delivery. Named registration and reservation, attribute update/reflection delivery, delete, DDM, ownership transfer, FOM sharing policy, broader save/restore, resign-action disposition, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
